# Licences

## Game assets: all original, generated by this repository
| Asset | Origin |
|---|---|
| `assets/ships/*.glb` | `tools/actors.py` (Shapely + trimesh geometry) |
| `assets/enemies/*.glb`, `assets/fx/pickup_orb.glb` | `tools/actors.py` |
| `assets/kits/level_*.glb` (terrain, walls, rocks, landmarks) | `tools/terrain.py`, `tools/levels.py` |
| `levels/*.json` | `tools/levels.py` |
| `assets/audio/*.wav` (all effects + 8 music loops) | `tools/audiokit.py` (numpy synthesis, fixed seeds) |
| `assets/ui/icon_*.png` | `tools/icons.py` (Pillow polygons) |
| `assets/palette.json` | `tools/palette.py` |

No third-party art, audio, fonts or textures are used. The UI font is Godot's built-in default (Godot's licence covers it).
No names, designs, layouts, music or sounds from existing games, films or franchises are used.

## Engine & tools
| Component | Licence | Ships in build? |
|---|---|---|
| Godot Engine 4.7.2 (and its bundled third-party components) | MIT, see https://godotengine.org/license | yes |
| Python 3 | PSF | no (build tool) |
| Shapely | BSD-3-Clause | no |
| trimesh | MIT | no |
| NumPy, SciPy | BSD-3-Clause | no |
| Pillow | MIT-CMU (HPND) | no |
| mapbox_earcut | ISC | no |
| manifold3d | Apache-2.0 | no |

For a Steam release, include Godot's licence text and third-party notices (`godot --license` / Engine.get_license_info()) in the credits or a `licenses/` folder.
